## Checklist

<!-- Open a draft as soon as you're ready - this doesn't need to be all tickable before sharing WIP -->

- [ ] This pull request does one thing, described above
- [ ] Tests pass locally (`python -m pytest src/`)
- [ ] There are new tests for new functionality (and bug fixes), or we discuss example outputs above or offline
- [ ] Python code passes automatic checks (`ruff format .` and `ruff check .`)
- [ ] Documentation updated if usage/functionality changed
- [ ] Ready for review (or left as a draft, on purpose - tag relevant people for discussion)
